abstract: We report a case of the mediastinal teratoma associated with acute cardiac tamponade followed by emergency operation. This tumor causes a variety of complications, but reports of acute cardiac tamponade have been rare. 20-year-old male admitted into our hospital with complaint of the chest pain, who was diagnosed with mediastinal tumor. She was admitted due to sudden fever up, and 5 days after admission, the complaint of severe epigastralgia and abdominal swelling were occurred. A chest X-ray film and chest computed tomography (CT) revealed cardiac tamponade. We carried out emergency surgical pericardial drainage and extirpation of the tumor. The tumor was composed of cystic part involving of dark green fluid macroscopically. The amylase level in this fluid was 42 U/l. We observed a small hole on the pericardial sac beside the base of ascending aorta. The amylase level in pericardial effusion was 19 U/l. Histopathological diagnosis was mature teratoma perforating into pericardiac sac, which included skin, bronchus and pancreatic tissue. We concluded that the progress of the tumor and the mechanical inflammation were major cause of perforation of the tumor into the pericardial sac, and autodigestion by enzyme from pancreas was minor cause of perforation.
abstract_ja: 我々は、急性心タンポナーデを合併し、緊急手術が行われた縦隔奇形腫の症例を報告する。この腫瘍は多様な合併症を引き起こすが、急性心タンポナーデの報告はまれである。20歳の患者が胸痛を主訴に当院に入院し、縦隔腫瘍と診断された。入院後、突然の発熱が生じ、入院5日後に激しい心窩部痛と腹部膨満が出現した。胸部X線写真および胸部コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)で心タンポナーデが認められた。緊急で外科的心膜ドレナージと腫瘍摘出を施行した。腫瘍は肉眼的に暗緑色の液体を含む嚢胞性部分から成っていた。この液体中のアミラーゼ値は42 U/lであった。上行大動脈基部近くの心膜嚢に小孔を認めた。心膜液中のアミラーゼ値は19 U/lであった。病理組織学的診断は、皮膚、気管支、膵組織を含む、心膜嚢に穿通した成熟奇形腫であった。腫瘍の進行と機械的炎症が穿孔の主な原因であり、膵臓由来の酵素による自己消化が副次的な原因であったと考えられた。
